name: Murone (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Murone village emblem in white: a ring enclosing a stylised mountain of three peaks.
history: Flag of the former village of Murone in Iwate Prefecture, dissolved on 2005-09-20. The municipal emblem was adopted on 5 September 1958.

features.role: Murone village emblem — a ring enclosing a stylised mountain of three peaks
